thread:
zoe: Hi all starting week 1 here. Quick docs question: I found a 'New hire checklist' but the Duplicate option is greyed out. I'm trying to spin up a copy for my onboarding notes.
devex-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm you're in the Redwood workspace 2) Check if the page is part of a database template vs standalone 3) See if the page is locked. If it's view-only you'll need to request edit access.
zoe: I'm definitely in the workspace. The page looks like a normal doc but there's no three-dot menu on my phone. On desktop the menu shows but Duplicate is disabled.
michael: Most likely it's either a locked master copy or a database template. If it's a DB template you'll need to create a new row from the database using the template rather than duplicating the page.
tara: @zoe I just checked: that checklist is the canonical "New hire" template stored in People Ops > Templates and intentionally locked to prevent edits. I can either unlock it briefly or give you a duplicate with edit perms.
zoe: Unlock would be great so I can duplicate and then move the copy into My Workspace.
people-ops: Gave @zoe Can edit on People Ops > Templates > New hire checklist and unlocked the page for 10 minutes. Also FYI we prefer new hires to copy into My Workspace and then move the copy into team spaces once approved.
zoe: Duplicate appeared after refresh, thanks! Two follow-ups: where do I put onboarding notes vs team-runbooks? And how do I discover who owns a page in future?
michael: Onboarding/personal notes -> My Workspace or People Ops > Personal Onboarding (private). Team-runbooks -> Company Home > Eng > Runbooks (shared with eng-oncall). If it's an ops runbook, keep it in eng-runbooks so oncall can find it.
people-ops: For ownership, we try to keep an Owner property in the page header. If it's missing, add a small 'Doc meta' block at the top with Owner, Last updated, and Contact. That helps triage later.
zoe: Totally. Also I tried to copy a DB template earlier and accidentally duplicated the whole DB into my workspace. Is there a quick cleanup step?
infra-bot: Tip: delete the accidental DB copy and then use the original database's New -> Template option. If you need rollback, open the unwanted page ->  -> Page history and restore or delete. Contact infra if something weird persists.
 tara: Another pro tip: if Duplicate is disabled but invite -> request access isn't showing, sometimes the page was shared with a group that blocks duplication. Ping the owning channel or @people-ops with the URL and we'll adjust.
zoe: Awesome, this cleared it up. I'll move my copies and add a doc-meta header with owner. Thanks everyone :) :tada:
people-ops: Welcome Zoe! If you want, drop links to your copies and we'll confirm the owner/permissions.
zoe: Will do within the hour.
